description: Election Commission - Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha - 2024 Filling at a Vacancy in the Office of Member Under Section 66A (1)(a)
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a Member of the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha (a local government authority) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process triggered by a resignation and the subsequent nomination by a political party secretary, culminating in the official declaration of a new elected member. The content is exclusively focused on an electoral process at the local government level, fitting the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for matters related to candidate nominations and declarations.
